# Runwall

> Zero-trust governance and policy-enforcement platform for AI agents, built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Intercepts agent tool calls and enforces policy without requiring code changes to the agent stack.

Runwall sits as a proxy between AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) and the tools they call, applying OPA/Rego policy rules, taint tracking, and semantic risk scoring in real time.

## Docs
- [Getting Started](https://runwall.in/docs): How to connect Runwall to an existing MCP-based agent stack
- [Policy Engine](https://runwall.in/docs/policy-engine): OPA/Rego rule authoring reference
- [Identity & Access Control](https://runwall.in/docs/identity-access): OAuth and API key gateway management for agent sessions
- [Risk Scoring Engine](https://runwall.in/docs/risk-scoring): Real-time risk assessment for agent tool invocations

- [Pricing](https://runwall.in/pricing): Plans and billing details
